articles.title: Stocks in news: UltraTech Cement, Tata Motors PV, Axis Bank, Apollo Hospitals and Ircon
articles.description: Indian equity markets saw a decline on Wednesday, influenced by Middle East tensions and rising oil prices. Several companies will be in focus today due to corporate developments and first-quarter earnings reports. UltraTech Cement shares are set for a block deal, while Apollo Hospitals reported strong profit growth. Lenskart Solutions and Astral also announced significant profit increases for the first quarter.

articles.title: Rupee ends modestly higher on RBI intervention
articles.description: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee experienced a modest increase, managing to withstand the upward pressure of crude oil prices. Support from the Reserve Bank of India's dollar sales played a crucial role in maintaining a stable trading environment, with the rupee fluctuating between 95.25 and 95.44. Traders are optimistic, anticipating an even stronger performance for the rupee on Thursday, bolstered by the recent ceasefire agreement that eased Brent crude futures.

articles.title: Oil prices edge up amid US-Iran deadlock
articles.description: Oil prices rose slightly on Wednesday as attacks on ships in the Middle East continued and talks to end the Iran war hit an impasse. However, the gains were limited after forecasters cut global oil demand projections for 2026.
